title: Canonical tensor and inverse-Hom twisting of tower classes
statement: For a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a scheme $T$ and Chern data [def-sp-tower-class-chern], define positive twisting to be sheaf tensor with the actual scalar-extended root line. Define twisting data as an equivalence whose forward functor is this tensor, whose inverse objects and maps are internal Hom from that line, whose coevaluation sends $x$ to $(y\mapsto x\otimes y)$, and whose evaluation sends $f\otimes y$ to $f(y)$. Its unit-line comparison sends $a\otimes y$ to $ay$; both functors are exact and additive. Localize them to define positive and negative ordinary derived twists, with their unit and contraction comparisons, consistently with [sk-def-sp-tate-twist]. For geometric pullback, the finite realizations [def-sp-tower-class-diagonal], and the normalized line pullback [def-sp-tower-class-pullback], define positive tensor transport by its equality on all pure tensors. Its projection arrow is the counit mate under the recorded pullback/direct-image adjunction. No arbitrary tensor equivalence or unspecified projection arrow is substituted.
